title: COROS Just Put a FLASHLIGHT in a $799 Watch 🔦
description:
COROS just put a built-in flashlight in its expedition watch — but there's a catch. 🔦

The COROS Vertix 4 is the first Vertix with an integrated flashlight. It has a 1.47-inch sapphire AMOLED screen up to 3,500 nits, a case 14% thinner than the Vertix 2S (13.8 mm), and up to 30 days of daily wear (COROS claim, always-on display off).

The catch: it's $799 — $100 more than the Vertix 2S at launch. Standard GPS battery drops from 118 to 105 hours, and satellite maps don't arrive until 2027.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 55/100 → SPEC, just barely. Grab it if your climbs start before sunrise.
